changes.newValue:
Redefine UILayout zone rects for portrait canvas (1080×1920). Portrait zones: TOP_STATUS (notch+HUD, ~0–80px), APP_HEADER (~80–180px), APP_BODY (scrollable, ~180 to viewport_height-120), BOTTOM_NAV (~last 120px). Also apply the portrait design system colour tokens in DS.gd — deep navy bg (#0a121d), cyan primary (#3fa9ff), amber accent (#f5a623). Reference: portrait/colors_and_type.css for the full token set.

Depends on P1.
